title: DNS patterns starting `**.` now match several subdomain levels

detection.reason: read from the agent's Cilium projection (feature names, never the policy's values); needs Cilium collection switched on in Integrations

quote: If you have any existing patterns that start with `**.`, they will now match multiple subdomains.
remediation: Each policy the command lists has a `matchPattern` beginning `**.`, which widens on 1.19 from one subdomain level to any depth. Replace it with `*.` where one level was intended.
verifyCommand: kubectl get ciliumnetworkpolicies.cilium.io,ciliumclusterwidenetworkpolicies.cilium.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $p | [(.spec // empty), (.specs[]?)] | map(((.ingress // []) + (.egress // []) + (.ingressDeny // []) + (.egressDeny // []))[]) | select(any(.[]; ((.toFQDNs // []) + [(.toPorts // [])[].rules.dns[]?]) | any((.matchPattern // "") | startswith("**.")))) | $p | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row has a **. DNS pattern

title: `fromRequires` / `toRequires` must be empty — the CRD now rejects them

detection.reason: read from the agent's Cilium projection (feature names, never the policy's values); needs Cilium collection switched on in Integrations

quote: The `CiliumNetworkPolicy` and `CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy` CRDs now enforce that the `FromRequires` and `ToRequires` fields are empty.
remediation: Cilium 1.19 no longer evaluates `fromRequires` / `toRequires`: a policy already stored keeps loading, but its requirement is IGNORED, so peers it used to exclude become allowed — the policy silently gets broader. Any later update to such a policy is rejected by the CRD. Before upgrading, rewrite every policy the command lists so the requirement is expressed in its `fromEndpoints` / `toEndpoints` selectors, then remove the two fields.
verifyCommand: kubectl get ciliumnetworkpolicies.cilium.io,ciliumclusterwidenetworkpolicies.cilium.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $p | [(.spec // empty), (.specs[]?)] | map(((.ingress // []) + (.egress // []) + (.ingressDeny // []) + (.egressDeny // []))[]) | select(any(.[]; ((.fromRequires // []) | length != 0) or ((.toRequires // []) | length != 0))) | $p | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # each row has a fromRequires/toRequires requirement that 1.19 stops enforcing
